source_inspections.trigger: Closest direct comparison of Alternative Vote/instant runoff and Coombs restricted to three candidates.

value.rationale: With three candidates, STV and Coombs differ only in the criterion used to choose the single eliminated candidate before the same pairwise runoff. The exact first electorate where that design choice changes a unique winner is therefore a natural comparison invariant. Its collapse to one anonymous orbit, with Coombs always retaining and electing the Condorcet winner while STV removes it, gives a compact structural explanation of the first divergence.
